translation.name: Nzuwulai n Sa'avu na̱ Tsishingini na̱ a̱ɗiva̱ a na a ɗangulai a Nzuwulai mu Ufaru

book.name: Mmaci ma Ibrahim
book.title: Mepepelime a̱ tyo ya Mmaci ma Ibrahim

content: Ama a̱ va̱, A̱sula̱ a ɗangwa ɗu ta̱ yo oꞌwo ama a akiza a̱ yi. Adama o ndolo i yuwusan majiyan cine Yesu ri aajiya a̱ A̱sula̱, waru a̱yi ɗa aabara a nan ganu vu ucawu wo okolo a̱ tsu.
U yuwan ta̱ a̱ɓula̱ e ili i na A̱sula̱ a ɗangwa niyi u yuwan suru, cine Musa yuwain a̱ɓula̱ e ili i na A̱sula̱ a damma niyi u yuwan suru, a̱tsuma̱ a tsugbain tsa̱ yi va aza a Israꞌila.
Yesu tsura̱ ta̱ tsugbain tsa na tsa laꞌai za va Musa, cine suwi tsu tsura̱ tsugbain tsa na tsa laꞌai usaa u na u yuwain.
Amayun a ɗa ozo o ro ɗa a suwai ꞌwaꞌa suru, amma A̱sula̱ a ɗa suwi vi ili suru.
A̱sula̱ a lyawa ta̱ uꞌwa wa̱ yi e ekere a Musa, adama a na Musa aagbashi a̱ a̱ɓula̱ a ɗa a na a zuwaa ucira, waru iroci i ɗa i na A̱sula̱ oo roco elime.

Zamawawa† gba waru Mawun ma̱ A̱sula̱ ma ɗa, a̱yi ɗa za na A̱sula̱ a lyawayi uꞌwa wa̱ yi. A̱tsu ɗa uꞌwa wa̱ yi na̱ tsu lyuwa elime na̱ ma̱tsura̱ mo okolo ugbamu, waru na̱ tsu zuwa ucira o uzuwu wo okolo a̱ tsu ya̱ꞌa̱ yi.
Tsu ꞌyuwan tsu ciga tsu lyuwai elime ni itoni ya̱ A̱sula̱
U ta̱ cine Ruhu va Akiza dammai,

content.text: “Na̱ yu uwwa uɗyo wa̱ A̱sula̱ anaꞌan,
she i da̱na̱ na aciyogbamu
cine nkaya n ɗu n da̱na̱i wan,
ana a vadalayi A̱sula̱ ucina̱,
a mantsa ma na a̱ lyungwa̱i A̱sula̱ o ogozo.
A̱sula̱ a damma ta̱,
‘Reve a̱ lyungwa̱ mu,
adama e ene ili i na maa yuwan,
ko na wo oꞌwoi e ene ta̱ ili i na n yuwain
a̱tsuma̱ a aꞌwan amunga.
Adama o ndolo n yuwan ta̱ upan ne ele lon,
reve n damma:
“Okolo e le a̱ tsu da̱na̱ ta̱ alanga na̱ a̱mu.
Waru a ꞌyuwan ta̱ a yuwan ili i na n damma nle a yuwan.”
N yuwan ta̱ upan reve n kucinaa le,
“Aa uwa uba̱ta̱ u wivuwun u va̱ shi, ko keꞌen.” ’ ”

content: Ama a̱ va̱, i yuwan ugbozu adama she za ta̱ ɗu da̱na̱ no okolo e iwuya, a na waa ꞌyasan ɗu a ca okolo wan. Icuꞌun yo okolo o ndolo a tsu vadala ɗu ta̱ diga uba̱ta̱ wa̱ A̱sula̱ a wuma.
I da̱shila̱i okolo ugbamu urana suru. Waru i lyuwa elime na̱ mayan ne n de nu urana wu lo. Ni i yuwan ne shi, unusu u ta̱ pusa̱a̱n ozo o ro a̱ ɗu a na e reme a zuwa le a̱tsuma̱ a aza a aciyogbamu.
A̱tsu tsu to oɓolo na̱ Kristi Zamawawa na̱ tsu lyuwa elime hali a̱ tyo o ukosu nu ucawu wo okolo o ugbamu u na tsu ri na̱ a̱yi diga o ufaru.

content.text: “Na̱ yu uwwa uɗyo wa̱ A̱sula̱ anaꞌan,
she i da̱na̱ na aciyogbamu,
cine nkaya n ɗu n da̱na̱i wan
ana a vadalayi A̱sula̱ ucina̱.”

content: Nan zane ɗa a uwwai uɗyo wa̱ A̱sula̱ꞌa̱ reve a yuwaan yi aciyogbamu? Ele ɗa aza a na Musa uta̱yi a̱tsuma̱ a Masar suru.
Nan zane ɗa waru A̱sula̱ a yuwain upan ne ele a̱tsuma̱ a aꞌwan amunga? Ele ɗa aza a na a yuwain unusu, aza a na a̱ kuwa̱i a̱tsuma̱ o ogozo.
Waru nan zane ɗa A̱sula̱ a yuwusain adanshi ana u kucinai na aa uwa uba̱ta̱ u wivuwun wa̱ yi shi? Aza a na a ꞌyuwain a yuwaan yi tsutoni ɗa.
Tsu ta̱wa̱ ta̱ tsu reve a na aa gura uwa uba̱ta̱ u wivuwuꞌun shi, adama a na a ꞌyuwan ta̱ a̱ usu.

footnotes.text: Na̱ Tsuheleni idanshi “Uꞌwa wa̱ A̱sula̱” urevu wa̱ yi u ɗa “Aza a Israꞌila.”
